method: Ball-pivoting open observed-surface reconstruction; separate supported 2.5-D ground triangulation
coordinate_frame: Same local metric frame as the registered point clouds; X along row, Y across, Z up
normal_orientation: each normal oriented toward the scanner that supplied the nearest measured point
limitations: Observed-surface interpolation only; occluded regions and unsupported gaps remain open.
The result is not a watertight solid or validated leaf-area/volume/CFD geometry.
Mesh surface area depends on sampling, voxel size and reconstruction thresholds.
Ground and tree surfaces are separate components; stakes/trellis inside the point crop can remain.
Alignment uncertainty is inherited from the point clouds; meshing does not resolve it.
